# Vertical Addiction

> > Canmore-based mountain sports retailer specializing in climbing, ice climbing, and alpine equipment from brands like Black Diamond, Petzl, La Sportiva, and Mammut.

Serving the Canadian Rockies since 2005, Vertical Addiction offers comprehensive gear for climbers, skiers, and mountain athletes, plus expert services including ski boot fitting (Atomic Memory Fit), equipment repair, and binding mounts from their Alberta location.

## Climbing Equipment

- [CLIMBING Collection](https://vertical-addiction.com/collections/climbing): Main climbing gear collection featuring harnesses, carabiners, and equipment
- [CLIMB Collection](https://vertical-addiction.com/collections/climb): Comprehensive climbing collection with carabiners, protection, ropes & slings
- [Belay Devices + Accessories](https://vertical-addiction.com/us/climb/harness): Belay devices from Black Diamond, Petzl, Edelrid & Wild Country brands
- [Black Diamond Solution Guide Harness - Women](https://vertical-addiction.com/products/black-diamond-solution-guide-harness-wmn): Women's all-season harness for big walls, alpine & ice climbing

## Ice Climbing

- [ICE CLIMBING Collection](https://vertical-addiction.com/us/ice-climbing): Ice climbing gear from Petzl, Black Diamond, Camp & Grivel brands
- [Ice Tools + Axes](https://vertical-addiction.com/us/ice-climbing/ice-axes-tools): Premium ice axes & tools from Petzl, CAMP & Black Diamond for vertical ice
- [IceLines Guidebook](https://vertical-addiction.com/products/icelines-guidebook): Ice climbing guidebook covering waterfall routes in Canadian Rockies

## Educational Resources

- [What Are Approach Shoes? Beginner's Guide](https://vertical-addiction.com/blogs/blog/what-are-approach-shoes-the-ultimate-beginners-guide): Comprehensive beginner guide explaining approach shoes vs hiking boots
- [Alpine Touring Bindings Guide 2026](https://vertical-addiction.com/blogs/blog/alpine-touring-bindings-explained-tech-vs-frame-bindings-in-2026): 2026 guide comparing tech, frame & hybrid AT bindings for backcountry skiing
- [10 Tips for Alpine Climbing](https://vertical-addiction.com/blogs/blog/10-tips-to-get-you-started-climbing-in-the-alpine): Beginner tips for alpine climbing including gear, training & safety advice
